title: A population ledger
hook: Track two ways a closed population can change.

knows: Animals interact with other organisms and their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: A toy population starts with 20 animals. Four are born and three die; no animals enter or leave. How many remain?

misconception: One observation or model rule gives a complete answer about nature.
objective: A toy population starts with 20 animals. Four are born and three die; no animals enter or leave. How many remain?

claims.text: A toy population starts with 20 animals. Four are born and three die; no animals enter or leave. How many remain? The stated ledger gives 20 + 4 − 3 = 21 animals. This arithmetic describes only the assumed closed population; it is not an estimate of a real population.
claims.source: Unverified reference lead for independent check: OpenStax Biology 2e, ecology and populations, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e . Exact claim-specific sources have not been verified.

claims.text: The panels depict a simplified illustrative scenario, not observations or measurements of real animals.
A closed toy population starts at 10, has 3 births and 1 death. What is the new count? 10 + 3 − 1 = 12.
